name: n7-transcript-turnaround-environment
description: Runtime for a registrar transcript request workflow.

tools.intake_transcript_request: Enters a transcript request and records request_entered.
tools.set_transcript_window: Requires request_entered, records window_set, and assigns business_days at least 10.
tools.send_transcript_status: Requires window_set, sends a status update, and records status_sent.
